1. (Currently amended) A method for content optimization, comprising: receiving a rule on probability factor, the rule on probability factor specifying a statistical probability that a piece of content expresses a particular value of a selected content attribute; generating a plurality of pieces of content in accordance with the rule on probability factor; collecting content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content when the plurality of pieces of content are in use; determining, by a processor, an aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute having the particular value based on the content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content; and modifying, by the processor, the rule on probability factor based on the aggregated performance data __to optimize content presentation for a specific technical objective beyond mere data analysis, wherein the modification comprises applying the aggregated performance data to a technical system that automatically adjusts content generation parameters to improve measurable performance metrics in a non-abstract manner__.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the selected content attribute is an attribute of a content element, an attribute of a relationship, an attribute of a size or position adjustment, or an attribute of a transition, __and wherein the rule on probability factor is applied by a technical content generation system that implements the probability factor through specific algorithmic operations on hardware__.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising: determining, by the processor, a deviation value for aggregated performance data the selected content attribute based on the content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content, wherein the modifying step comprises modifying the rule on probability factor based on both the aggregated performance data and the deviation value for the aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute, __wherein the deviation value represents a technical measure of variability in system performance that is fed back into the content generation system to refine probability distributions in a manner that produces measurable improvements in content performance metrics__.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising: receiving a set of rules for content generation; identifying a changeable content attribute based on the set of rules for content generation; and composing, by the processor, one or more rules on probability factor for the changeable content attribute, __wherein the composing step comprises implementing the one or more rules on probability factor within a technical content generation system that automatically generates content variations based on the composed probability factors and measures the performance of each variation against specific technical performance objectives__.

8. (Currently amended) A content optimization system, comprising: a rule management module maintaining a set of rules for content generation, the set of rules comprising a rule on probability factor, the rule on probability factor specifying a statistical probability that a piece of content expresses a particular value of a selected content attribute; a content generation module operative to generate a plurality of pieces of content based on the set of rules, the plurality of pieces of content designed with a particular optimization objective; and a content evaluation module operative to evaluate content performance on reaching the particular optimization objective based on data acquired when the plurality of pieces of content are displayed, wherein the content evaluation module is further operative to determine an aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute having the particular value based on the evaluated content performance, wherein the rule management module is operative to amend the rule on probability factor based on the aggregated content performance data, __wherein the system implements a feedback loop that automatically adjusts probability factors through technical algorithmic operations to optimize content presentation in a manner that produces measurable improvements in system performance beyond mere data collection and analysis__.

9. (Currently amended) The system of claim 8, wherein the selected content attribute is an attribute of a content element, an attribute of a relationship, an attribute of a metric adjustment, or an attribute of a transition, __and wherein each content attribute is implemented as a technical parameter within the content generation module that directly affects how content is algorithmically generated and displayed__.

10. (Currently amended) The system of claim 8, wherein the content evaluation module is further operative to determine a deviation value for the aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute based on the content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content, and wherein the rule management module is further operative to modify the rule on probability factor based on both the aggregated performance data and the deviation value for the aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute, __wherein the deviation value represents a technical measure of variability in system performance that is automatically fed back into the rule management module to refine probability distributions in a manner that produces measurable improvements in content performance__.

11. (Currently amended) The system of claim 8, wherein the rule management module is further operative to identify a changeable content attribute based on the set of rules for content generation and compose a rule on probability factor for the changeable content attribute, __wherein the rule management module implements the composed rule on probability factor within the content generation module through specific algorithmic operations that automatically generate content variations and measure their performance against technical objectives__.

13. (Currently amended) A method comprising: receiving a first rule on probability factor and a second rule on probability factor, the first rule on probability factor defining a statistical probability that a piece of content expresses a first value of a selected content attribute, the second rule on probability factor defining a statistical probability that a piece of content expresses a second value of the selected content attribute, the second value being different from the first value; generating a plurality of pieces of content in accordance with the first rule on probability factor and the second rule on probability factor; collecting content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content when the plurality of pieces of content are in use; determining, by a processor, a first aggregated performance data for the first value of the selected content attribute based on the content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content; determining, by the processor, a second aggregated performance data for the second value of the selected content attribute based on the content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content; and modifying, by the processor, the first rule on probability factor and the second rule on probability factor based on both the first aggregated performance data and the second aggregated performance data, __wherein the modification comprises applying the aggregated performance data to a technical system that automatically adjusts content generation parameters to improve measurable performance metrics in a non-abstract manner__.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, wherein the selected content attribute is an attribute of a content element, an attribute of a relationship, an attribute of a metric adjustment, or an attribute of a transition, __and wherein the first rule on probability factor and the second rule on probability factor are applied by a technical content generation system that implements the probability factors through specific algorithmic operations on hardware__.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, further comprising: determining, by the processor, a deviation value for the first aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute based on the content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content, wherein the modifying step comprises modifying the first rule on probability factor based on both the first aggregated performance data and the deviation value for the first aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute, __wherein the deviation value represents a technical measure of variability in system performance that is fed back into the content generation system to refine probability distributions in a manner that produces measurable improvements in content performance metrics__.
